verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents AI Gateway, a gateway layer with caching, rate limiting, retries, model fallback and usage/cost metrics that takes one line of code to adopt. Separately, Workers AI offers 50+ open-source models through a single API call. However, the evidence never shows a single unified endpoint spanning 'hundreds' of models or third-party providers. missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of models (only 50+ documented), an explicit single unified endpoint across providers/models, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
